question: What boundary is marked for the sacred area addressed to Shankari?
premises: A clay image marks a location.
The boundary extends up to the confluence of Kapila.
inference: The sacred boundary extends from the clay image up to the confluence of Kapila.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of saṅgamāvadhi as a boundary marker is interpretive.
plain_english: At the clay image, up to the confluence of Kapila, O Shankari.
